thread:
Priya R.: Hey team, opened a small PR to tweak the docs streaming examples: adds a Deno snippet, clarifies resume token handling, and fixes a pagination link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4180
Evan L.: Nice. Is the Deno example a separate file or inline in the TS section?
Priya R.: Inline, under TS examples. Keeps footprint small but shows `fetch` + ReadableStream usage.
Diego M.: Can you paste the Deno streaming snippet here? I'm curious how you show resume decoding.
Priya R.: Sure:
```ts
// deno example: resume token decode
const token = response.headers.get('x-resume-token')
if (token) {
  const decoded = atob(token) // deno has atob
  // pass decoded as cursor on next request
}
```
Evan L.: We should be explicit: some runtimes give base64, others already return raw cursors. Add a one-line note.
Priya R.: Added note: "Resume tokens may be base64-encoded depending on client; decode with Buffer/atob as appropriate."
Marta S.: I fixed a dead link to the pagination guide and updated the anchor id. Also added a tiny paragraph about token accounting for streaming responses (how partial tokens count).
Diego M.: For Go snippet, can we show a minimal retry wrapper around the streaming call? Small sample is fine.
Priya R.: Yes, I added a 3-line retry example using backoff. Kept defaults small for readability with a note: "Increase backoff in prod."
Evan L.: Lint note: the `atob` call in TS will fail in Node unless you use `Buffer.from(..., 'base64').toString()`. Maybe show both variants.
Priya R.: Good call. Added both variants with labels: "Node: Buffer..." and "Deno: atob(...)"
Marta S.: Ran prettier and black; only change was a wrapped comment in the Python snippet. No behavioral changes.
docs-bot: CI for PR #4180 passed with warnings: code-samples lint (warn). Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/4180
Diego M.: Quick QA: tested the Deno flow locally and the resume header is present. Edge case: when stream ends normally, server omits header. Added a guard in the example.
Priya R.: Pushed a tiny update handling missing header.
Evan L.: +1 from me after a quick glance. Docs render looks fine in preview.
Marta S.: +1 (link fixed, formatting ok)
Diego M.: +1 (Deno & Go samples checked)
Priya R.: Merging in 15 unless anyone objects.
docs-bot: PR #4180 merged by Priya R.  deploy queued. :rocket:
